verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents alerting and notification channels, but nothing in the evidence pack shows a registrable outbound webhook that a programmatic consumer could receive to trigger remediation or agents. Generic notification-channel mentions and MCP-based alert management are adjacent features, not webhook delivery, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
